description: This file defines API endpoints for managing stock entries in a dealer management system using FastAPI. It includes routes for listing, creating, updating, and deleting stock entries, utilizing SQLAlchemy models and schemas for data validation and transformation.

methods.name: Decimal _compute_total_cost(unit_cost: Decimal, quantity: int)
methods.description: Calculates total cost by multiplying unit cost with quantity and rounding to two decimal places.

methods.name: List[StockEntry] list_stock_entries( dealer_id: int | None = Query( None, description="Optional dealer id to filter stock entries", ), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200, description="Max number of stock entries to return"), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of stock entries to skip"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of stock entries, with optional dealer filtering and pagination.

methods.name: StockEntry create_stock_entry(payload: StockEntryCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new stock entry, computing total cost automatically.

methods.name: StockEntry update_stock_entry( stock_id: int, payload: StockEntryCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing stock entry, re-calculating total cost if relevant fields change.

methods.name: None delete_stock_entry(stock_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a stock entry by ID.
